representability_gate.reason: The frozen schema and security allowlist cannot express mathematically correct moment/couple interactions without shared schema and trusted-computation changes.
missing_renderer_capabilities: signed scalar moment about a point with clockwise/counterclockwise sense
3D position-force cross product and right-hand-rule moment vector
moment projection about a specified axis
force-couple reduction at a reference point
missing_trusted_formula_capabilities: M = F d with signed rotational sense
residual couple = sum of force moments plus applied couples
line-of-action offset = resultant moment divided by resultant force
representability_gate.why_existing_renderers_cannot_be_reused: A vector-plane renderer can display force components but does not declare moment arcs, couple free vectors, point/axis moment semantics, line-of-action relocation, or 3D right-hand-rule state. Reusing it would pass labels through the wrong trusted semantic adapter.
representability_gate.stop_condition_triggered: shared schema change and formula allowlist material security redesign required

linkage_impact.reason: No artifact may claim explanation, procedure, or worked-example linkage until a semantically correct trusted renderer and formula adapter exist.
